    """Check if object is grabbed and lifted at least `distance` above the surface."""

+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_robolab import Session
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+
+
+def main():
+    s = Session("block_stacking_specified_order", instance=INSTANCE)
+    p = s.primitives()
+    objs = s.objects()
+    print("initial EE", s.ee_pose())
+    print("finger closing dir", p["get_finger_closing_dir"]())
+    print("objects", {k: v["position"] for k, v in objs.items() if k.endswith("_block")})
+
+    # Red is already resting on the table and serves as the fixed tower base.
+    base_xy = np.asarray(objs["red_block"]["position"][:2], dtype=float)
+    table_top = float(objs["table"]["bounds"][1][2])
+    quat = p["top_down_quat"](0.0)
+    hover_z = table_top + 0.19
+    pick_z = table_top + 0.004
+
+    s.record_start()
+    p["open_gripper"](steps=12)
+    for name in ("blue_block", "green_block", "yellow_block"):
+        src, _ = p["get_object_pose"](name)
+        src = np.asarray(src, dtype=float)
+        # Approach over the source, grip around the block's lower half, then lift clear.
+        p["move_ee"]([src[0], src[1], hover_z], quat, speed=0.22, settle=2)
+        p["move_ee"]([src[0], src[1], pick_z], quat, speed=0.12, settle=2)
+        p["close_gripper"](steps=18)
+        p["move_ee"]([src[0], src[1], hover_z], quat, speed=0.15, settle=3)
+        held, _ = p["get_object_pose"](name)
+        print("picked", name, "at", held, "EE", s.ee_pose()[0], "steps", s.n_steps)
+
+        # Use the current tower top as the fingertip plane. The carried block's
+        # bottom is aligned with this plane when released.
+        stack_top = max(float(p["get_object_bounds"](n)[1][2])
+                        for n in ("red_block", "blue_block", "green_block")
+                        if n != name)
+        # For the current block, source bounds are not a support surface; the max
+        # over previously placed blocks is the target support height.
+        p["move_ee"]([base_xy[0], base_xy[1], hover_z], quat, speed=0.20, settle=2)
+        p["move_ee"]([base_xy[0], base_xy[1], stack_top + 0.001], quat, speed=0.10, settle=3)
+        p["open_gripper"](steps=18)
+        p["hold"](12)
+        print("placed", name, "at", p["get_object_pose"](name)[0],
+              "tower", {n: p["get_object_pose"](n)[0].tolist()
+                        for n in ("red_block", "blue_block", "green_block", "yellow_block")},
+              "status", s.status())
+        if s.episode_done:
+            break
+        p["move_ee"]([base_xy[0], base_xy[1], hover_z], quat, speed=0.16, settle=2)
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    print("recorded", actions.shape, "final live status", s.status())
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz", meta={"strategy": "top_down_pick_place_on_red", "base_xy": base_xy.tolist()})
+
+    # The first replay in this process follows RoboLab's exact replay path.
+    status = s.replay(actions)
+    print("first replay", status)
+    if not status["success"]:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"trajectory replay did not succeed: {status}")
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz", meta={"strategy": "top_down_pick_place_on_red", "base_xy": base_xy.tolist(), "replay_status": status})
+    print("saved /app/output/trajectory.npz")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
